newsitem.title: USA: Staples and Office Depot extend merger.
newsitem.headline: Staples and Office Depot extend merger.

text.p: Staples Inc and Office Depot Inc said Tuesday that, because of pending litigation with the Federal Trade Commission, each company has approved two amendments to their merger agreement.

The first extends the term of the merger agreement until June 30. The companies said they expect the U.S. District Court will have made its ruling with respect to a preliminary injunction requested by the Federal Trade Commission before this date.
In addition, the companies said they amended the agreement giving each one the right to terminate the merger agreement within four business days after the U.S. District Court has made its ruling.
The companies also said Tuesday they have moved the date of their special shareholder meetings to June 18, from May 28.

Staples and Office Depot signed a definitive agreement last September to merge into a single company pending regulatory and shareholder approval. The Federal Trade Commission is opposing their merger on antitrust grounds.
